flavor: A high, open-sided pavilion sits atop a jagged spire, where the constant, whistling gale carries the scent of ozone and dried lavender. At the center, a silver bowl sits atop a pedestal, its contents swirling in a miniature, perpetual cyclone.
name: The Zephyr's Altar
reason: The party seeks to commune with the Sky-Father to gain passage through the storm clouds ahead.
